title: Equality of a binary word and the input payload
statement: For natural numbers $n,p,oc$, the binary expansion of $oc$ equals the payload obtained by removing the unary prefix and separator from the pairing of a string of $n$ ones with the binary expansion of $p$ if and only if $oc=p$.
